podcast.title: Blondie's Record Label
podcast.body: Chrysalis Records was Blondie's record label during the period of their first two albums, *Blondie* and *Plastic Letters*. "They were with Chrysalis records and they wanted Blondie to get a hit so they hooked them up with producer Mike Chapman."

srcs.episode: Ep. 57 - Punk and New Wave at New York's CBGB

podcast.title: Push for a Hit
podcast.body: After the first two albums failed to gain commercial traction, Chrysalis Records brought in producer Mike Chapman to help Blondie achieve a hit, demonstrating the label's investment in the band's commercial success. "They were with Chrysalis records and they wanted Blondie to get a hit so they hooked them up with producer Mike Chapman."
